lines.trans: Thankfully we prepared in advance, Xingzi; you really have experience.
Working beside the boss, I have been through this more than once or twice.
Whenever he rolls out something new, that is when every side bristles the most.
At times like this, keep the boss from meeting them if possible, or a fight will break out.
Chun Yuqiao even gets into fights? Is his temper really that fiery?

lines.trans: He is not hot-tempered; he simply means every word he says.

His trust in us truly goes beyond anything we imagined.
When it comes to work, the boss really is never autocratic.
